label: Stock Alerts
description: Email customers when a product they asked about is back in stock, and alert your team when stock runs low.

fields.label: Send back-in-stock emails
fields.description: While off, restocks do not email anyone and subscriptions stay waiting. New subscriptions are still saved. Setting a subscription to Notified by hand in the dashboard always emails the customer.

fields.label: Match subscriptions to the exact variant
fields.description: When on, a subscription made for a specific variant is only notified when that variant is restocked. When off, a product coming back in stock (total from 0 or less to above 0) notifies every subscriber to it whatever variant they chose; a restock of a single variant while the product total is already above 0 still notifies only that variant's subscribers.

fields.label: Alert admins on low stock
fields.description: Email store admins when a product's stock drops to or below its low-stock threshold.

fields.label: Default low-stock threshold
fields.description: Used for products that have no threshold of their own. Set a per-product threshold on the product's Stock alerts tab.

fields.label: Daily low-stock digest
fields.description: Send one summary email per day listing every open low-stock alert.
